meta.company: PITT OHIO — LTL Trucking, Supply Chain & Logistics Services
meta.description: Daily sales machine for LTL freight reps: sourcing, research, cold calling, follow-up, and CRM — automated and tracked.

stage_roles.compiler: Output sales workflow PDF, CRM template, lead tracker sheet, cold call script card

call_rotation.script: Hey [name], this is [you] with PITT OHIO. I see you move a lot of [lane]. We run that lane daily — trucks positioned and ready. I'm not asking for a contract. I'm asking for one load. What do you have moving today or tomorrow?
call_rotation.notes: Always name a specific lane. Never pitch. One load.

touches.content: Got a truck open tomorrow if you need it
One page, 3 sample lanes, competitive rates
Circle back. Pause if no interest.
